svg.title: FXLoop: your agent sees, clicks, explains and reloads your JavaFX app
svg.desc: Your agent talks to FXLoop over MCP. FXLoop starts your JavaFX app, or connects to it when you start it with the FXLoop build plugin. Asked about a cut-off Save button, the agent takes a screenshot, clicks New to open the dialog, learns that the button's prefWidth is too narrow for its text, fixes the code, reloads the app live and confirms the fix.
svg.text: You describe the problem in plain words.

text.tspan: Your agent gets a screenshot of the running app.
Real clicks, and every action reports what changed.
FXLoop says what is wrong, and why.
The agent fixes your code, and the app updates live.
It compares before and after. Lint is clean.

svg.text: Fixed, without asking you what happened on screen.
